Summaries.eng: With his straw hat and ragtag crew, young pirate Monkey D. Luffy goes on an epic voyage for treasure in this live-action adaptation of the popular manga.
Summaries.jpn: 麦わらの一味とともに大海原へ。若き海賊モンキー・D・ルフィは、ひとつなぎの大秘宝を求めて冒険の旅へとこぎ出していく。国民的人気漫画を実写化。

Aliases: ONE PIECE INTO THE GRAND LINE

Titles.eng: Cobra Kai's Jacob Bertrand Visits the Set of ONE PIECE

Summaries.eng: When the worlds of ‘Cobra Kai’ and ‘One Piece’ collide, you know you’re in for a good time. Such was the case when superfan Jacob Bertrand, known for his role as Hawk in ‘Cobra Kai,’ surprised the cast of ‘One Piece’ in South Africa.

Titles.eng: Iñaki Godoy Meets the One Piece Creators

Summaries.eng: One Piece star Iñaki Godoy (Monkey D. Luffy) tours the offices of Shueisha Games, publishers of Oda Sensei's manga and creators of the original anime series. Iñaki views storyboards for the One Piece anime pilot and shares how much the manga means to him.
"I can’t imagine anyone else but you" ???? Come along with us on a dream visit to the studio of the legendary Eiichiro Oda.

Titles.eng: A very special message from Eiichiro Oda

Summaries.eng: NAKAMA!!! ????‍☠️???? It fills us with great joy to give you this message directly from Oda-Sensei

Titles.eng: The One Piece Cast Reacts to Audition Tapes

Summaries.eng: One Piece stars Iñaki Godoy (Luffy), Emily Rudd (Nami), Taz Skylar (Sanji), and Jacob Romero (Usopp) watch and react to the self-tape auditions that got them booked in leading roles.

Titles.eng: Meet the New Season 2 Cast (Netflix Geeked Week 2024)

Summaries.eng: One Piece co-showrunner Matt Owens and newly announced Season 2 stars Joe Manganiello (Mr. 0) and Lera Abova (Miss All-Sunday) preview what to expect from Baroque Works' most dangerous duo. The One Piece Season 2 casting was announced as part of Netflix's Geeked Week 2024 event.

Summaries.spa: El joven pirata Monkey D. Luffy y su variopinta tripulación emprenden un viaje épico en busca de un tesoro.
Summaries.rus: Молодой пиратский капитан вместе со своей командой отправляется в путешествие, чтобы завоевать титул короля пиратов и обнаружить мифическое сокровище, известное как «One Piece».
Summaries.pt: O jovem pirata Monkey D. Luffy veste o chapéu de palha e, com sua tripulação atrapalhada, zarpa em uma jornada épica.
Summaries.por: O jovem pirata Monkey D. Luffy pega no seu chapéu de palha e zarpa com a sua tripulação em busca de um incrível tesouro.

Summaries.eng: Stranded on a sinking boat, carefree Luffy begins his journey in search of a pirate king's lost treasure. But first, he'll need a crew, a ship and a map.
Summaries.jpn: 海賊王が遺したひとつなぎの大秘宝(ワンピース)を見つけるという夢を胸に、沈みかけのボートで大海に漕ぎ出したルフィ。まずは仲間、まともな船、そして海図を手に入れるために、いざ出航!

Titles.eng: THE MAN IN THE STRAW HAT
Titles.jpn: THE MAN IN THE STRAW HAT

Summaries.eng: After securing a map to the Grand Line, Luffy, Nami and Zoro are taken hostage by a no-nonsense clown. New cadet Koby is cornered by Vice-Admiral Garp.
Summaries.jpn: 偉大なる航路(グランドライン)への海図を手に入れたものの、道化のバギーに捕らわれてしまうルフィ、ナミ、ゾロ。一方、海軍に入隊したてのコビーは、ガープ中将に詰め寄られる。

Summaries.eng: In need of a proper ship, the gang reaches Syrup Village and meets the cheerful Usopp and his best friend Kaya. A sinister threat disrupts their plans.
Summaries.jpn: 海賊団にふさわしい船を調達しようとシロップ村を訪れたルフィたちは、陽気なウソップと親友のカヤと出会う。だが彼らの行く手には、邪悪な敵が待ち受けていた。

Summaries.eng: With his friends in danger and Klahadore's plan in motion, Usopp seeks help from the Marines. Blades clash when a fierce battle erupts at Kaya's mansion.
Summaries.jpn: 計画の実行へと動くクラハドール。仲間たちに危機が迫る中、ウソップは海軍に助けを求める。火花を散らす刃。カヤの屋敷で激しいバトルが勃発する。

Summaries.eng: The Straw Hat Pirates face their first adversary as a group. At a floating fish house, Luffy befriends a cook, and Zoro enters a duel with a warlord.
Summaries.jpn: 大海原に漕ぎ出し、麦わら海賊団として新たな敵に立ち向かう。海上レストラン"バラティエ"で、ルフィは店で働くコックと出会い、ゾロは王下七武海の1人に一騎打ちを挑む。

Titles.eng: THE CHEF AND THE CHORE BOY
Titles.jpn: THE CHEF AND THE CHORE BOY

Summaries.eng: Sanji and head chef Zeff put their differences aside to save a severely wounded Zoro. A ruthless Fishman on a mission stirs up trouble for the crew.
Summaries.jpn: サンジと料理長ゼフのいつもの口論は一時休戦。瀕死の傷を負ったゾロの命を救うために力を合わせる。一方、ルフィ達の前には野望に満ちた冷酷無慈悲な魚人が現れ、仲間の危機をもたらす。

Titles.eng: THE GIRL WITH THE SAWFISH TATTOO
Titles.jpn: THE GIRL WITH THE SAWFISH TATTOO

Summaries.eng: After striking a deal with a familiar foe to find Arlong, Luffy and his friends set sail for Coco Village and learn about Nami's mysterious past.
Summaries.jpn: アーロンを見つけるため、例のアイツと手を組んだルフィと仲間たちは、ココヤシ村に向けて船を進める。この村で、ナミの謎に包まれた過去が明らかになっていく。

Summaries.eng: The Straw Hat crew strives to take down Arlong and the Fishmen once and for all. After a tense family reunion, Luffy inches closer to his dreams.
Summaries.jpn: アーロンと魚人海賊団を壊滅させるべく、麦わらの一味は決死の戦いに挑む。家族との対峙も果たしたルフィは、海賊王への夢にまた一歩近づく。

Titles.eng: ONE PIECE INTO THE GRAND LINE
